rationale: Class 2 review of the full matching source rows shows that each XBRL residual date is the maturity printed for the specific flagged position, while the identifier carries a different date. The mismatches follow sibling-row contamination (including funded versus unfunded/revolver dates) or cross-row contamination; Appfire's identifier date 02/24/2031 is not its printed maturity, which is 03/09/2028.
